# bundled-symbols

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The saved-icon drawings of a host without the computer's icon sets (the browser composition): provides the RuntimeSymbolDrawer from the Material Symbols set bundled with the worker (weight 400, every shape and fill; a light style draws its 400 drawing), loaded lazily and only on a miss. Its warm-up draws every saved name in every style and keeps those drawings in the host's storage (a picker's are held in memory only), so a build-time snapshot ships the demo's icons drawn and a visitor never loads the set for them. Never booted by the desktop.
- Excluded: yes
- Server:
  - Contributes: `host-service:icons.runtime-symbol-drawer` "icons.runtime-symbol-drawer"
  - Uses:
    - `infra/warmup.defineWarmup`
    - `ui/icons/sprites.drawRuntimeSymbol`
    - `ui/icons/sprites.RuntimeSymbolDrawer`
    - `ui/icons/sprites.RuntimeSymbolDrawerImpl`
    - `ui/icons/sprites.savedIconNames`
  - Register: `defineWarmup('icons.bundled-symbols.draw-saved')`
